title: Majorization Inequalities from Logarithmic Convexity
summary: Majorization inequalities for symmetric polynomials have interested mathematicians for centuries, from the AM-GM inequality for two variables going back at least to Baudhāyana's Śulbasūtra and Euclid's Elements in the first millenium BCE, through classical results of Newton, Muirhead and Gantmacher, to more recent extensions to Schur polynomials and zonal spherical functions. These have been established case by case, with no unified approach.
